name: Pager
summary: Proposed (order C5). Full width pages a person swipes between, one at a time, with the dots of Pagination under them: the screens of an onboarding, the steps of a short tour. Built on scroll snap, so the swipe is the browser's own; arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down and the dots are the paths with no drag.
useWhen: A short line of pages read one at a time, such as three onboarding screens
Content that a person swipes through on a phone and that also needs the keyboard and a screen reader path
avoidWhen: More than about eight pages, where nobody can count the dots
Steps of a task that must be done in order, with checks between them
Views of one object a person compares, where tabs show the names
A row of cards a person scans, where several should show at once

label.description: Required. The name of the pages as a whole, the viewport's accessible name: Introduction (Arabic: المقدمة).

page.description: The current page, from 1, controlled with onPageChange.

defaultPage.description: The page it opens at, from 1.

onPageChange.description: Called with the page after a swipe settles (scrollend, or a short pause where it is missing), a key or a press on a dot. Never in the middle of a swipe.

dots.description: Draws Pagination with variant dots under the pages (part dots). Not drawn for one page.

dotsLabel.description: The name of the dots: Introduction pages. Arabic default: الصفحات.

live.description: Makes the viewport a polite live region, for pages that change on their own (anatomy rule 13).

PagerPage.description: One page, a direct child of Pager. A group whose role description is page (Arabic: صفحة) and whose name is its place, 2 of 3 (Arabic: 2 من 3). Pages that are not current are inert.

a11y.role: The viewport is a region named by label and one Tab stop (a scroll container must take focus). Each page is a group with aria-roledescription page in the Pager's language and the name 2 of 3. The dots are Pagination dots, a nav of buttons named Page 2 of 3.
a11y.focus: The viewport, then the controls of the current page, then the current dot. Pages out of view are inert, so Tab never lands in one. A key or a dot changes the page without moving focus.

keys.ArrowRight: On the viewport: the next page; the previous one in right to left. Stays at the last page.
keys.ArrowLeft: On the viewport: the previous page; the next one in right to left. Stays at the first page.
keys.PageDown: On the viewport: the next page.
keys.PageUp: On the viewport: the previous page.
keys.Home: On the viewport: the first page.
keys.End: On the viewport: the last page.
keys.Tab: From the viewport into the current page, then to the dots.

a11y.announce: The current dot carries aria-current page. With live, the new page is read politely when it changes.
notes: The swipe has two paths with no drag: the keys on the viewport and the dots (WCAG 2.5.7).
Keys pressed on a control inside a page stay with that control. When the page changes while focus is in the page that leaves (a swipe), focus moves to the viewport, never to the body.
Right to left: the row of pages follows the reading direction, so the first page is at the right and a swipe to the left goes forward.
Under reduced motion (the media query, or data-motion="reduce" on the page) a change from a key or a dot jumps at once; the swipe itself is the browser's scroll.
The server render shows the page asked for and sets no scroll; the scroll is set after mount.

en.label: Name the pages as a whole, a noun: Introduction. Built in words: page, 2 of 3, Pages.

ar.label: اسم المجموعة كاسم: المقدمة. الكلمات المدمجة: صفحة، 2 من 3، الصفحات. أرقام غربية.

react.behavior: scroll snap container with role region; PagerPage groups; Pagination variant dots; keys on the root
react.note: Proposed, order C5. No animation library: the swipe is native scrolling with scroll snap; a change from a key, a dot or the page prop scrolls with scrollBy, smooth or instant under reduced motion. The page changes when the scroll settles.

styles.studio: Base layout only: pages edge to edge, the dots centred under them.
styles.neutral: Base layout only; on ios the dots sit on their small platter (Pagination).
styles.liquid: Base layout only; on ios the dots sit on their glass platter (Pagination).

mistakes.wrong: Pagination dots beside a hand made stack of pages swapped by state
mistakes.right: Pager, so a swipe moves the pages and the dots and keys follow it

mistakes.wrong: Every page in the tab order
mistakes.right: Only the current page: the others are inert, so focus never lands out of view
